summaries.Romania: Romania narrowly avoids a credit rating downgrade after Moody's and Fitch maintained sovereign ratings despite negative outlooks, signaling urgent need for fiscal consolidation. Major infrastructure projects face challenges: the Danube's low water levels forced emergency measures at Cernavodă nuclear plant, while a Ukrainian drone incident near the Bulgarian border raises regional security concerns.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare AI adoption accelerates with 90%+ of health systems deploying tools, but governance gaps persist as only 44% have dedicated data platforms; simultaneously, insurers report positive Q2 cost management results while facing 15% median ACA rate hikes for 2027.
summaries.Tech: Apple's September event approaches with reports of iPhone 18 Pro split launches and foldable iPhone Ultra in two colors, while Amazon's planned Texas data center power plant could become the nation's largest single source of greenhouse gas emissions, and OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide to bolster ChatGPT capabilities.

items.title: Industry Voices—AI won’t fix nurse burnout. Nurses will
